file.description: Path relative to the checkout root.

line.description: Line number, or 0 for the whole file.

title.description: Short one-line title naming the problem, at most 80 characters.

suggested_comment.description: Comment to the PR author, ready to post as an inline review comment on that line: what is wrong and how to fix it, constructive, no severity prefix.

tags.description: One or more kinds of problem.
